# IOracleRegistryEvents
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/rwa-oracles/src/interfaces/IOracleRegistryEvents.sol)

**Title:**
IOracleRegistryEvents

Interface defining events emitted by OracleRegistry.


## Events
### OracleSet
Emitted when a new oracle is registered or updated for a ticker and asset.


```solidity
event OracleSet(string indexed ticker, address indexed asset, address indexed oracle);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`ticker`|`string`|The string symbol of the asset.|
|`asset`|`address`|The address of the asset contract.|
|`oracle`|`address`|The address of the price oracle contract.|
